comment: [SHEET/TAG-CONT] tag-continuity known failures: Sheet donor ids (Donor Overrides + Donor Clusters) that resolve to no donor in ANY artifact, so the editorial work on that row reaches nothing. Measured against the UNION of both artifacts, never one — the Sheet is shared across both tools, so a per-artifact count is misleading (EDIT-SAFE-1 G0 §3). SHRINK-ONLY: max_entries may never rise; the checker fails in code if entries exceed it, if an entry lacks an owner, or if a listed entry no longer fails. SHRUNK 1 -> 0 and PINNED AT ZERO on 2026-08-08 — the file's first and terminal shrink. It landed at one for the single true orphan, a re-mint signature whose fix was always editorial rather than code; S5 (Ishan's Sheet action — the orphan's Donor Overrides row deleted) is what earned it, and the checker then DEMANDED the removal rather than anyone electing it. With the pin at zero, any future orphan fails the build by construction and is a finding, never an entry.
